answer: In the Prism registry, each AI agent key must anchor an identity by locking a refundable 100-USDC bond for 90 days plus burning an irreversible 10-USDC activation fee, verified via on-chain deposit receipts. At the zenith of a Sybil attack, spawning N keys scales linearly, costing 100N USDC in locked capital and 10N USDC burned; resetting keys forfeits burned fees and restarts lockups.
